title: Đêm dài
about: Round x5 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa"): a long night, the longest piece: one slow journey through most of the sounds, each section handing over to the next (pad, wind, choir, strings, bells, glass), almost no tune, to listen to for a long while. D minor at 48 bpm. An original piece.
